meta.title: Axolotl Launcher — a modern launcher for Minecraft
meta.description: Axolotl Launcher is an open-source, cross-platform Minecraft launcher focused on speed, reliability and a quiet interface.

footer.tagline: An open-source, cross-platform Minecraft launcher built for speed.

home.title: Minecraft, reimagined.
home.lead: An open-source, cross-platform Minecraft launcher. Faster starts, dependable downloads, fewer distractions.

sections.featuresLead: A launcher should not be disposable. Axolotl separates versions, dependencies and downloads into recoverable layers, so one failure never takes the whole instance with it.
sections.isolationBody: Every instance owns its version, mods and configuration. Switching packs never overwrites an old world, and a rollback only touches the layer that broke.
sections.repairBody: Libraries and asset indexes are verified before launch, missing pieces are fetched on demand, and a failed start keeps its state so the next attempt resumes where it stopped.
sections.sourcesBody: The update service, GitHub and GitLink are all available. When one source times out, the downloader moves on without asking you to watch a progress bar.
sections.flowTitle: Four steps back to the game.
sections.flowInstallBody: Grab the package for your platform; the first run checks the runtime.
sections.flowChooseBody: Create an isolated instance from a release, snapshot or modpack.
sections.flowLaunchBody: Dependencies, Java and your account are ready in one pass.
sections.flowRollbackBody: When a version misbehaves, return to the last known-good state.
sections.capabilitiesTitle: Everything you need, nothing in the way.
sections.capAccountsBody: Microsoft sign-in and offline profiles coexist; switching never disturbs an instance.
sections.capJavaBody: The right runtime for each Minecraft version, with missing JDKs fetched automatically.
sections.capModsBody: Import a Modrinth modpack and resolve dependencies and updates in one pass.
sections.capOfflineBody: Launch a prepared instance even when the network is gone.
sections.capThemesBody: Light, dark and OLED surfaces that follow the system or switch by hand.
sections.capOpenBody: Code, release pipeline and docs live in public repositories: auditable and self-hostable.
sections.ctaTitle: Make the next launch a better one.
sections.ctaBody: Download Axolotl, or read the docs first and decide after.
